title: Motifs
description: Output of stage 1. Produced either from games the user has played (path A) or from their answers to the preference questions (path B). Stage 3 consumes this and must not be able to tell which path produced it.
$comment: Path A additionally requires each motif's evidence to name at least two DISTINCT game sources. That rule is deliberately NOT in this schema, because the same schema is shared with path B where there are no games to cite. It is enforced in code. See spec.md criteria 2 and 3.

motifs.description: Zero motifs is a valid and expected answer, meaning no shared throughline could be identified. The app must never manufacture a connection to fill this array. See spec.md part 5, pitfall 1.

name.description: Short label for the motif. Should describe how something feels or what the player is doing, not a genre.

description.description: What this motif is, in plain language.

evidence.description: What this motif is drawn from. A motif that cannot point at anything is meaningless — see spec.md part 5, pitfall 10.

source.description: A game title on path A, or a question identifier on path B.

detail.description: The specific thing in that source which supports the motif. Not a restatement of the motif name.
